Third-Party Wafer Foundry Facilities

Other Third-Party Manufacturers
We outsource board-level graphics product manufacturing to third-party manufacturers.
Assembly, Test, Mark and Packaging Facilities
Wafers for our products are either sorted by the foundry or delivered by the foundry to our assembly, test, mark and packaging (ATMP) partners or subcontractors located in the Asia-Pacific region, who package and test our final semiconductor products. We are party to two ATMP joint ventures (collectively, the ATMP JVs) with Tongfu Microelectronics Co., Ltd. The ATMP JVs, Siliconware Precision Industries Ltd. (SPIL) and King Yuan Electronics Company (KYEC) provide ATMP services for our products.

calibration_v2.kind: Synthetic judge calibration, not corpus evaluation
assessment: V2 distinguishes supported from contradicted/missing-context evidence in faithfulness and separates irrelevant content in answer relevancy.
Answer relevancy remains about .957 for both supported and contradicted answers and for the supported answer paired with missing context. It is not a correctness metric.

Context precision near 1 for supported contexts containing an irrelevant second passage reflects ranked average precision with the useful item first; it is not the fraction of passages that are relevant.

Each distinct answer has three independently generated uncached relevancy samples with sample indices 0,1,2 and distinct keys. Missing-context reuses the same answer/question relevancy draws; context-independent reuse is appropriate and does not establish new independent draws. Other identical judge prompts also reuse cache.

Calibration is synthetic judge compatibility/directionality evidence, not corpus evaluation, score reliability estimation, or validation of all financial edge cases. Preliminary calibration.json is excluded.
